summary: Consultations module tested successfully. Backend: 15/15 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All UI flows working - list view, form, detail view, eyeglass Rx dialog, medical Rx dialog, patient consultations tab. Fixed bug: Frontend was using wrong endpoint '/api/prescriptions/eyeglasses' instead of '/api/prescriptions/eyeglass'.

backend: Consultations list items have required fields (_id, patient_id, consultation_date, consultation_type, chief_complaint)
POST /api/consultations creates consultation with clinical fields
GET /api/consultations/{id} returns full detail with linked prescriptions
POST /api/prescriptions/eyeglass with consultation_id links prescription to consultation
POST /api/prescriptions/medical with consultation_id links prescription to consultation
GET /api/patients/{id} includes consultations array in response
All consultation types accepted (general, control, urgencia, primera_vez, seguimiento)
Eyeglass prescription can be created without consultation_id
Medical prescription can be created without consultation_id
